what_this_is: A small DEV set of synthetic pages, each built for one way extraction can go wrong. It is development evidence: the extractor may be changed in view of it, so passing it proves the listed properties on these pages and nothing about pages in general.

gates.set_by: Trustora engineering, 2026-10-12, before any extractor change; a project gate, not a literature-derived threshold; carried over unchanged to v2 on 2026-10-12

security.basis: measured here through the real parsing child; DTD, entity, include and credential properties are held by the test suite

definitions.expected segment: a string that a reader of the page sees and that the evidence must carry
definitions.forbidden segment: a marker placed in navigation, footer, script, style, form controls or markup-hidden elements, plus any case-specific string that is not part of the page's own content
definitions.expected path: article text for a page that is an article, structured text for a page that is not; 'either' where both are honest readings; 'none' where nothing on the page is fit to return

history: A first draft of this set (15 cases) was run once against the committed extractor before the set was frozen. That run showed the malformed fixture had an unclosed <title>, which leaves any HTML parser, a browser included, with an empty page; the fixture was corrected. Five cases were added for the risk recorded on 2026-10-12, a news card on a page that is not an article: two with a short card and three with a card long enough for the article extractor to take. No extractor code had been changed. The draft result was discarded; the baseline is the run of this frozen file.

v2 (2026-10-12): the 20 cases of v1, unchanged, plus 13 added after an independent review showed that v1 could not tell whether the rules worked: every article fixture in v1 declares an article and no other fixture does, so the declaration alone separated them. The added cases are the reviewer's shapes (a page that declares an article and is not one, content made of links, a card with and without its own heading) and the two live shapes that the running-text rule exists for. v2 was frozen, and run against the committed extractor and against the first E1 change, before that change was revised. r-09 is included knowing that nothing deterministic may be able to pass it.
